notes.title: [The main creator said] A little bit of the main creator's thoughts
notes.content:
Hello, everyone, this is the president of creating software and Bielast, the leader of this project [Bai Xiao]. This project, which spanned two years, was finally released today.
I'm really excited right now, and I don't know where to start with a lot of things I want to say. First of all, I would like to thank everyone in the community who have given their leisure time and energy to this project. If it wasn’t for the cooperation of everyone, this project would definitely not have reached this stage. In a physical education class two years ago, the two current vice presidents and I started the animation master session in the fish, chatting and chatting about "Passerby Heroine", and collided "Being a gal together" "Wonderful idea. But the lack of technical skills in the first year and the lack of connections in the school made it all imaginary. After I was promoted to the second year of senior high school, I got to know the two current information competition leaders by chance (meaning that our club occupies 1/5 of the provincial team A places and 2/15 of the provincial team places). a turnaround. After that, I kept drawing cakes and shaking people, and finally came to this point. There are many small partners who only joined the production in the middle. I would like to thank the composer who joined after the first announcement and the cover artist who found us on the forum. It was only with your participation that the work was upgraded to one. new level. There is also our main program in Kangaroo Country, which still helped us finish the program under the pressure of taking the national team for the math competition, and often stayed up late with me until the early morning with a 2-hour time difference (actually, I was supervising the work). Fishing doesn't do anything). During a National Day holiday, the copywriting team who finished writing the script, asked the Youth League Committee teacher to discuss the vice president of the club with me, and also came to help with the operation in Nanshan.... The touching production highlights are really Too many to list all. "This is a story that everyone completed together." As Guo Huang said, this is a miracle for all of us.
"One side is thinking about what to do, the other side is worrying about what to do, and even worrying about growing up without doing anything." With this thought in mind, everyone gathered together and wanted to do something. Make a little memory. Finally, we found "things that we can do too, things that we can devote ourselves to." Piecing them together in this "most important place", we finally left a beautiful dream, a beautiful period of time. remember.
At the same time, we would like to thank our friends who gave us suggestions and help during the production process. thank you all! These suggestions have saved us a lot of detours in our inexperienced groping. Really thank you all! You are also welcome to continue to provide valuable comments and report typos and bugs without proofreading.
Ps: Many friends are asking questions about the sequel. After we graduate from high school, the current club will be on the stage in a new form, so stay tuned! At the same time, I am also looking forward to the works of the next class of students.

notes.title: "Bai Xiao" has officially passed the review!
notes.content:
[h1][b]The review of "Bai Xiao" was officially approved! Now confirmed to be released at 10:00 am (UTC) on May 3, 2022[/b][/h1]
[h3] I’m very sorry for the delayed ticket for a month! This time [b][h1]really[/h1][/b] will be released! The game will be released for free on the Steam platform, welcome to download and play . [/h3]
